resources.string: Turn your body into a game controller. Roaming detects your motion on this device and broadcasts it to other apps.
Hardware step detector plus device tilt. Keep the phone in your hand or pocket.
On-device pose detection with the front camera. Stand back so your body is in view, or for an elliptical or bike, just your head, shoulders and arms. Frames never leave the device.
Allow the motion bubble over other apps
Roaming needs this permission to detect motion
This device has no step detector; use the camera instead
Private by design: everything runs on this device, there is no network access, no location and no health data is stored.
Only use Roaming where you have room to move and nothing to trip over or bump into, away from traffic, stairs, water and other people. Keep track of your surroundings at all times.

Roaming turns your body movement into game input. Moving while you look at a screen can lead to falls, collisions and injuries.

• Only use Roaming in a safe environment: a clear, flat area with enough space around you, away from traffic, stairs, open water, furniture, pets and other people.
• Keep track of your surroundings at all times. The motion bubble regularly reminds you to look up.
• Stop immediately if you feel pain, dizziness or shortness of breath, and check with a doctor before starting a new exercise routine.
• Make sure the phone is mounted or held securely so it can't fall.
